report_name: Infostealer Exposes Blind Eagle APT Operator's Toolkit

threat_actors.name: Blind Eagle
threat_actors.description: A Spanish-speaking cyber-espionage group, primarily targeting entities in South America. An operator associated with the group had their workstation infected by an infostealer, exposing the group's malware development activities and infrastructure choices.
threat_actors.goals: Cyber-espionage against government and financial institutions.

attack_patterns.name: Create Account: Cloud Account
attack_patterns.description: The Blind Eagle operator used legitimate commercial cloud services, including Firebase for C2 and email marketing services like Brevo, Mailrelay, and HubSpot for phishing, by creating accounts to build out their attack infrastructure.

attack_patterns.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor researched and used crypters and protectors such as FUD Crypter, MI6 Crypter, PolyCrypt, and Cassandra Protector to obfuscate malware payloads and evade detection by antivirus software.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The Blind Eagle operator utilized email marketing services like Brevo, Mailrelay, and HubSpot to conduct phishing campaigns.

attack_patterns.name: Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor used Firebase as a flexible and resilient command-and-control (C2) infrastructure, a common tactic to blend C2 traffic with legitimate web services.

malware.name: FUD Crypter
malware.description: A crypter tool researched and used by a Blind Eagle operator to obfuscate malware payloads and make them 'Fully Un-Detectable' (FUD) by antivirus software.

malware.name: MI6 Crypter
malware.description: A crypter tool identified from the compromised browser history of a Blind Eagle operator, used for malware obfuscation.

malware.name: PolyCrypt
malware.description: A crypter tool identified from the compromised browser history of a Blind Eagle operator, used for malware obfuscation.

malware.name: Cassandra Protector
malware.description: A protector tool identified from the compromised browser history of a Blind Eagle operator, used for malware obfuscation.

tools.name: Firebase
tools.description: Used by the Blind Eagle operator as a flexible and resilient command-and-control (C2) infrastructure.

tools.name: Brevo
tools.description: An email marketing service used by the Blind Eagle operator, likely for phishing campaigns.

tools.name: Mailrelay
tools.description: An email marketing service used by the Blind Eagle operator, likely for phishing campaigns.

tools.name: HubSpot
tools.description: An email marketing service used by the Blind Eagle operator, likely for phishing campaigns.

tools.name: DreamHost
tools.description: A commercial hosting provider used by the Blind Eagle operator for hosting C2 servers and malicious payloads.

tools.name: HostGator
tools.description: A commercial hosting provider used by the Blind Eagle operator for hosting C2 servers and malicious payloads.

identities.name: Government institutions in South America
identities.description: A primary target sector for the Blind Eagle APT group, with a specific focus on entities in Colombia.

identities.name: Financial institutions in South America
identities.description: A primary target sector for the Blind Eagle APT group, with a specific focus on entities in Colombia.

infrastructure.name: Blind Eagle C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Command and control infrastructure hosted on legitimate commercial services like HostGator, DreamHost, and using Firebase to blend in with normal traffic.

infrastructure.name: Blind Eagle Phishing Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Infrastructure for phishing campaigns built using commercial email marketing services such as Brevo, Mailrelay, and HubSpot.

indicators.name: Blind Eagle Infrastructure Hosting Domains
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Suspicious DNS Queries to Blind Eagle Related Hosting Providers
id: 2b1a3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to hosting providers and services known to be abused by the Blind Eagle APT group for C2 and payload hosting.
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/blind-eagle-malware/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-31
tags:
  - attack.t1102
  - attack.command_and_control
level: low
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - '.firebaseio.com'
      - '.hostgator.com'
      - '.dreamhost.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries to domains associated with services abused by Blind Eagle for infrastructure. While these services are legitimate, monitoring for suspicious or newly observed subdomains can indicate malicious activity.

indicators.name: Blind Eagle Associated Crypter Strings
indicators.pattern:
title: Detection of Blind Eagle Associated Crypter Strings
id: 9d8c7b6a-5f4e-4d3c-2b1a-0987654321fe
status: experimental
description: 'Detects strings in files associated with crypters used by the Blind Eagle APT group, as identified from an operator OPSEC failure.'
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/blind-eagle-malware/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-31
tags:
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Contents|contains:
      - 'FUD Crypter'
      - 'PolyCrypt'
      - 'MI6 Crypter'
      - 'Cassandra Protector'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files containing strings related to crypters and protectors used by Blind Eagle operators to obfuscate their malware.
